Install the commit-msg hook that runs the commit gate

Source: R/use-hooks.R
use_hooks.Rd

Writes a commit-msg git hook that runs gate() on each commit (rules 6.1 to 6.3). It says what it will write before it writes anything, and running it again changes nothing. suppressMessages() silences it.

Usage

use_hooks(
  path = ".",
  remove = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  rscript = NULL,
  lib = NULL
)

Arguments

path

A directory in the project, which must hold _weft.yml and be inside a git work tree.

remove

Remove the hook instead of installing it.

overwrite

Replace a hook weft wrote that has since been edited.

rscript

The Rscript the hook runs. Default: the one of this R.

lib

The library paths the hook gives R, which must hold weft. Default: .libPaths().

Value

The paths written, invisibly (character() when nothing changed).

Details

The script is POSIX sh, written to the repository's hooks folder (the one git rev-parse --git-path hooks names, so a linked worktree uses the main repository's). It records the Rscript and the library paths of the session that ran use_hooks(), and runs R with --no-init-file --no-environ, so the project's .Rprofile (renv, weft_setup()) and .Renviron (which could replace the recorded library paths) are not read by the hook. When R or weft cannot be found the commit fails with a message that names use_hooks() and git commit --no-verify; the latter skips the hook for one commit.

  • No commit-msg hook, and core.hooksPath unset: the hook is written.

  • A hook weft wrote (it has a weft-file: use_hooks line) and has not been edited: rewritten when its text would differ, else kept. Edited: left as it is, unless overwrite = TRUE.

  • Another tool's hook, or core.hooksPath set (a hook manager): left alone, also under overwrite = TRUE. The script goes to <git common dir>/weft/commit-msg, and the call prints the line to add to the hook your setup runs (and a repo: local entry when there is a .pre-commit-config.yaml).

remove = TRUE deletes the hook when it is weft's (edited or not) and the folder <git common dir>/weft/ (the script copy and the gate's cache). Another tool's hook is left, and the call says to remove the weft line from it.
